description: Ask one follow-up and wait for the user's answer. Ask an open question by voice. Include options when a tappable list will help the user choose among known alternatives.

params.name: question
params.description: The question the user should answer, without any introductory text

params.name: options
params.description: Two to five distinct, short choices to display in a tappable list. Omit for a spoken question answered by dictation.
